candidate.state_condition: current route_state == HighVol and previous route_state == HighVol
candidate.signal: recent 5 one-minute log-return sum flips from positive to negative
candidate.direction: short, i.e. continuation in the new down direction
candidate.overlap: within each session, next event entry index must be >= prior event exit index

validation_primary_endpoint: mean new-direction continuation over 3 minutes, bp
validation_acceptance_rule: for each calendar slice 2024, 2025, and 2026 through 2026-08-21: n >= 15 and mean_continuation_3m_bp > 2.0
